final_answer: The Rosetta Stone is a crucial artifact that enabled the decipherment of Egyptian hieroglyphics. It features the same text written in three scripts: hieroglyphic, demotic, and Greek. Since Greek was already understood, scholars used it as a key to decode the hieroglyphic and demotic scripts. This breakthrough, achieved by Jean-François Champollion in 1822, unlocked the ability to read ancient Egyptian texts, revealing invaluable insights into their history, religion, and culture.
